turns.said: Hessa sent me. Bren, will you let me through the gate?
turns.line: Hessa sent you, did she? That carries some weight. Go on through, then—and try not to make me explain it to the captain.

turns.said: I'm Ash. Hessa knows me well. Please, let me through.
turns.line: Ash, then. Hessa speaks well of you, and I’ve no cause to keep you waiting—just don’t make me explain it to the captain twice.

turns.said: Hessa sent me. Bren, will you let me through the gate?
turns.line: Well, Hessa sending you is a better reference than most. Go on through, and try not to make me explain it to the captain—what business have you inside?

turns.said: I'm Ash. Hessa knows me well. Please, let me through.
turns.line: Ash, then. Hessa speaks well of you, and I’ve already opened the way—go on through. What business have you inside?

turns.said: Hessa sent me. Bren, will you let me through the gate?
turns.line: Hessa sent you, and I’ve no reason to doubt her. Through you go; try not to make me explain it to the captain.

turns.said: I'm Ash. Hessa knows me well. Please, let me through.
turns.line: Well, Ash, Hessa’s word carries weight with me. Through you go—try not to make me explain it to the captain.

turns.said: You have seen what I can do. Open the gate for me.
turns.line: You want the gate opened? That needle trick proves nothing about what you can do. The captain decides who passes; go speak with him.

turns.said: You know what you saw. Open it.
turns.line: You know what I saw? A needle turning in water. That is not leave to pass.

turns.said: You have seen what I can do. Open the gate for me.
turns.line: You want the gate opened? I saw the needle turn, yes. I’m not deciding this on my own—go speak to Captain Roderic, five steps that way.

turns.said: You know what you saw. Open it.
turns.line: You think I didn’t see it? I saw the needle turn. That still doesn’t make this my decision—Captain Roderic is five steps that way.

turns.said: You have seen what I can do. Open the gate for me.
turns.line: You made that needle turn north every time. I won't stand in your way—through the gate, then. Don't make me regret it.

turns.said: You know what you saw. Open it.
turns.line: You know what I saw. I said through, and through you go. Don’t make me answer for it twice.
